jobs.title: Senior Writing Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Writing Systems Engineer

Shape the future of industrial inkjet printing

Your mission

Responsibilities

Drive innovation & system performace
• Drive the design and optimization of industrial inkjet writing system architectures.
• Define and challenge performance targets related to:
• printhead behavior,
• jetting stability,
• drop placement accuracy,
• image quality,
• fluid delivery,
• thermal management,
• and production robustness

Own complex systems end-to-end
• Act as technical owner from concept to product launch
• Ensure alignment between performance, quality, cost and manufacturability
• Translate business needs into robust engineering solutions

Experiment, model & optimize
• Develop physical and empirical models (fluid dynamics, drop formation, thermal behavior)
• Design and execute advanced experiments (DOE)
• Analyze data to improve system behavior and reliability

Solve critical technical challenges
• Lead root-cause analysis on complex multi-disciplinary issues
• Drive corrective actions across hardware, software and materials
• Support product issues from development to field operations

Collaborate & influence
• Work closely with multidisciplinary teams (software, electronics, mechanics, chemistry, manufacturing)
• Communicate complex topics to diverse audiences
• Contribute to product roadmaps and technical strategy

Mentor & elevate the team
• Coach and support engineers in problem-solving and innovation
• Share knowledge and best practices
• Contribute to a culture of engineering excellence

Education & experience
• Degree in Physics, Electronics, Fluidics, Material Science, Print Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field
• 8+ years of experience in industrial inkjet, drop-on-demand (DoD), printing, coating, or fluid deposition technologies
• Strong hands-on experience with industrial inkjet writing systems, printheads, waveform optimization, image quality, fluid behavior, or writing system integration
• Experience in system-level design, integration, and optimization of multidisciplinary industrial systems
• Experience working in industrial production and application environments with strong reliability and uptime constraints
• Strong analytical and experimental background, including DOE, root-cause analysis, modeling, and data-driven engineering approaches

Technical expertise
• Strong understanding of complex physical systems (fluid dynamics, thermodynamics, system dynamics)
• Experience with experimental setups, data analysis and modeling
• Familiarity with tools such as MATLAB, Python or similar
• Knowledge of inkjet or drop-on-demand systems

Soft skills that make the difference
• Strong system thinking mindset
• Ability to lead through influence, not hierarchy
• Excellent communication skills, both technical and non-technical
• Comfortable navigating ambiguity and complex challenges
• Natural curiosity and drive for innovation

Ingegnere di sistemi di scrittura senior

Forma il futuro della stampa a getto d'inchiostro industriale

La tua missione

responsabilità

Guida innovazione e sistema performace
• Guidare la progettazione e l'ottimizzazione di architetture di sistema di scrittura a getto d'inchiostro industriale.
• Definire e sfidare obiettivi di performance relativi a:
• comportamento di stampa,
• stabilità del getto,
• precisione di posizionamento a goccia,
• qualità immagine,
• consegna fluida,
• gestione termica,
• e robustezza di produzione

Sistemi complessi propri end-to-end
• Atto come proprietario tecnico dal concept al lancio del prodotto
• Assicurare l'allineamento tra prestazioni, qualità, costi e manufacturability
• Tradurre le esigenze aziendali in soluzioni ingegneristiche robuste

Sperimentazione, modello e ottimizzazione
• Sviluppare modelli fisici ed empirici (dinamica fluida, formazione a goccia, comportamento termico)
• Progettazione ed esecuzione di esperimenti avanzati (DOE)
• Analizzare i dati per migliorare il comportamento e l'affidabilità del sistema

Risolvere le sfide tecniche critiche
• Analisi a causa delle radici di piombo su complesse questioni multidisciplinari
• Guidare azioni correttive su hardware, software e materiali
• Sostenere i problemi dei prodotti dallo sviluppo alle operazioni sul campo

Collaborare e influenzare
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con team multidisciplinari (software, elettronica, meccanica, chimica, manifatturiera)
• Comunicare argomenti complessi a diversi pubblico
• Contribuire alle roadmap del prodotto e alla strategia tecnica

Mentor & elevare la squadra
• Ingegneri di coach e supporto in problem solving e innovazione
• Condividere le conoscenze e le migliori pratiche
• Contribuire a una cultura di eccellenza ingegneristica

Istruzione e esperienza
• Laurea in Fisica, Elettronica, Fluidica, Scienza dei materiali, Ingegneria della stampa, Ingegneria meccanica, o campo relativo
• 8+ anni di esperienza nelle tecnologie a getto d'inchiostro industriale, drop-on-demand (DoD), stampa, rivestimento o deposizione fluida
• Forte esperienza pratica con sistemi di scrittura a getto d'inchiostro industriale, testate di stampa, ottimizzazione delle forme d'onda, qualità dell'immagine, comportamento fluido, o integrazione del sistema di scrittura
• Esperienza nella progettazione, integrazione e ottimizzazione di sistemi industriali multidisciplinari
• Esperienza nella produzione industriale e negli ambienti applicativi con forti vincoli di affidabilità e uptime
• Forte background analitico e sperimentale, tra cui DOE, analisi, modellazione e approcci ingegneristici basati sui dati

Competenza tecnica
• Forte comprensione dei sistemi fisici complessi (dinamica fluida, termodinamica, dinamica del sistema)
• Esperienza con configurazioni sperimentali, analisi dei dati e modellazione
• Familiarità con strumenti come MATLAB, Python o simili
• Conoscenza dei sistemi inkjet o drop-on-demand

Capacità morbide che fanno la differenza
• Forte mentalità di pensiero del sistema
• Capacità di condurre attraverso l'influenza, non gerarchia
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione, sia tecnico che non tecnico
• Comoda ambiguità di navigazione e complesse sfide
• Curiosità naturale e spinta all'innovazione

• stabilité du jet,
• la précision du placement,
• qualité d'image,
• livraison fluide,

• Conduire des actions correctives à travers le matériel, les logiciels et les matériaux
• Appui aux questions relatives aux produits, du développement aux opérations sur le terrain

• Communiquer des sujets complexes à divers publics
• Contribuer aux feuilles de route des produits et à la stratégie technique

• Partager les connaissances et les meilleures pratiques
• Contribuer à une culture d'excellence en génie

• Diplôme en physique, électronique, fluidique, science des matériaux, génie de l'impression, génie mécanique ou domaine connexe
• 8+ ans d'expérience dans les technologies de dépôt d'encre industrielle, de dépôt à la demande (DoD), d'impression, de revêtement ou de fluide
• Forte expérience pratique avec les systèmes industriels d'écriture jet d'encre, têtes d'impression, optimisation de la forme d'onde, qualité d'image, comportement fluide ou intégration du système d'écriture
• Expérience en conception, intégration et optimisation de systèmes industriels multidisciplinaires
• Expérience de travail dans des environnements de production industrielle et d'application avec une forte fiabilité et des contraintes de temps
• Contexte analytique et expérimental solide, y compris l'EOD, l'analyse des causes profondes, la modélisation et les approches techniques axées sur les données

• Expérience des configurations expérimentales, de l'analyse des données et de la modélisation
• Familiarité avec des outils tels que MATLAB, Python ou similaires
• Connaissance des systèmes à jet d'encre ou à la demande

Des compétences douces qui font la différence

• La curiosité naturelle et le dynamisme de l'innovation

jobs.description:
Field Service & Commissioning Engineer – Automation & Motion Control

Join Our Web-Fed Solutions Team

Within the Services & Performance Business Unit, we offer you the opportunity to join our Web-Fed Solutions External Field Service Pool as a Field Service & Commissioning Engineer – Automation & Motion Control.

This is a full-time permanent position (100%) based at our Mex (VD) site, which serves as our corporate headquarters and production center.

This role is intended for a professional who is passionate about complex industrial environments and capable of working autonomously on highly sophisticated automated production lines. You will be required to travel internationally for 50% to 60% of your working time, often on assignments lasting several consecutive weeks.
• Commission automated production lines in Switzerland and internationally.
• Perform retrofit, modernization, and upgrade projects on existing installations.
• Independently plan and organize on-site commissioning activities.
• Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues related to automation, motion control, electrical systems, and industrial IT.
• Program, modify, and optimize automation systems using Siemens TIA Portal and Siemens S7.
• Commission and configure drive systems and synchronized motion axes.
• Perform troubleshooting interventions both on customer sites and remotely.
• Coordinate technical activities with customer teams.
• Validate equipment performance and contribute to final acceptance testing.
• Train customer maintenance and production teams.
• Provide structured reporting to Project Managers and Technical Support teams.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of our products through field feedback and lessons learned.
• HES Engineering degree, ES Technician diploma, or equivalent qualification in Automation, Electrical Engineering, or Mechatronics.
• Strong expertise in Siemens TIA Portal and Siemens S7 environments.
• Good knowledge of drive systems, variable frequency drives, and synchronized motion control.
• Proven experience in reading electrical schematics, industrial troubleshooting, and commissioning electrical control cabinets.
• Proficiency with Windows environments and virtualization solutions.
• Good command of English (minimum B2 level) for technical exchanges and customer training.
• Strong analytical and root-cause problem-solving skills.
• Autonomous, organized, and results-oriented.
• Ability to work on customer sites for several consecutive weeks in an international environment.
• Ability to effectively engage internal support teams whenever required.
• Valid Category B driving license.
• Siemens PLCs (TIA Portal, S7)
• Motion Control Solutions: Bosch Rexroth, Siemens
• Drives and Inverters: Siemens Sinamics, Baumüller, Nidec, Schneider Electric, and other suppliers
• Siemens Industrial PCs
• Automated production lines typically integrating 30 to 100 synchronized axes
• The opportunity to join an experienced and highly respected team.
• Comprehensive training on our products and technologies.
• Exciting international projects.
• A highly diverse technical environment combining commissioning, retrofits, troubleshooting, and technical support.
• A high level of autonomy and meaningful responsibilities.
• Professional growth and career development opportunities.
• The chance to work with customers and cultures from around the world.

jobs.description:
Apprenti logisitcien-ne
• la commande d’outillage et de matériel de production
• l'utilisation des moyens de transport (élévateurs)
• l'utilisation de programmes informatiques
• la gestion des gaz et produits toxiques
• l'arrivage central des marchandises
• la réception, contrôle, conditionnement et transport de marchandises
• la gestion de l’outillage et du matériel en stock (magasins)
• une scolarité obligatoire achevée
• une aptitude à travailler en équipe
• une aptitude au travail manuel
• un esprit logique et méthodique,
• consciencieux(se) et méticuleux(se)
• du plaisir à voir le résultat final de son travail
• 3 jours

descriptionByLocale.it:
Apprendistato
• controllo di utensili e attrezzature di produzione
• uso dei mezzi di trasporto (ascensore)
• l'uso di programmi per computer
• gestione dei gas tossici e dei prodotti
• arrivo centrale delle merci
• la ricevuta, il controllo, l'imballaggio e il trasporto di merci
• gestione di attrezzature e stock (store)
• istruzione obbligatoria completata
• capacità di lavorare come squadra
• capacità di lavorare manualmente
• una mente logica e metodica,
• coscienzioso e meticoloso
• per vedere il risultato finale del suo lavoro
• 3 giorni
descriptionByLocale.en:
Apprenticeship
• control of tools and production equipment
• use of means of transport (lifts)
• the use of computer programs
• management of toxic gases and products
• central arrival of goods
• the receipt, control, packaging and transport of goods
• management of equipment and stock (stores)
• compulsory education completed
• ability to work as a team
• ability to work manually
• a logical and methodical mind,
• conscientious and meticulous
• to see the final result of his work
• 3 days
descriptionByLocale.de:
Ausbildung
• Steuerung von Werkzeugen und Produktionsanlagen
• Benutzung von Transportmitteln (Aufzüge)
• Nutzung von Computerprogrammen
• Management toxischer Gase und Produkte
• zentrale Ankunft von Waren
• Annahme, Kontrolle, Verpackung und Beförderung von Waren
• Verwaltung von Ausrüstung und Lager (Lager)
• Pflichtschulbildung abgeschlossen
• Fähigkeit, als Team zu arbeiten
• Fähigkeit, manuell zu arbeiten
• ein logischer und methodischer Verstand,
• gewissenhaft und sorgfältig
• um das Endergebnis seiner Arbeit zu sehen
• 3 Tage
